newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Banks to sign MOU with Victorias April 15.
newsitem.headline: Banks to sign MOU with Victorias April 15.

text.p: Victorias Milling Co and its 32 creditor-banks are to sign on April 15 a memorandum of agreement giving a 90-day debt payment reprieve to the cash-strapped sugar miller, Philippine Commercial International Bank (PCIBank) president Rafael Buenaventura said on Thursday.
PCIBank is the head of the creditors committee which has been negotiating with Victorias on the terms of a debt moratorium since early last month.

Buenaventura said the 90-day period would give Victorias time to prepare financial statements, sell its auxilliary businesses and invite new owners to infuse additional equity as well as for banks to draw up a long-term restructuring plan for the company's 4.423 billion pesos ($168 million) outstanding loan.
He said Victorias would probably be bid out to buyers, most of which were local companies including some sugarcane planters.
Victorias, one of the oldest sugar millers in the country, also has interest in engineering, management, technical serivces, agribusiness and food manufacturing.
